name: How can I maximize storage in a small bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize storage in a small bathroom, consider incorporating recessed shelving within walls, installing a vanity with integrated drawers, or adding open shelving above the toilet. Wall-mounted cabinets and mirrored medicine cabinets can also provide discreet storage without taking up floor space. Utilizing vertical space efficiently is key; think about tall, narrow storage units or shelving that extends to the ceiling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small bathroom storage with recessed shelving, integrated vanity drawers, and wall-mounted or vertical units.
